Use case: stylized-concept. Production-ready isolated pixel-art sprite for the existing medieval fantasy farming town-builder.
Match the reference village workshop's crisp detailed pixel clusters, dark outlines, honey-brown oak, warm-grey stone, blue-grey slate, restrained cream plaster and warm lantern lighting. Upper-left light. Strict orthographic 2:1 isometric projection: ground axes slope +0.5 and -0.5, vertical posts perfectly upright, left/front face and right side visible. Sharp edges, readable small silhouette, no blur, smooth gradients, glossy 3D or painterly brushwork.
One compact square one-cell ground plan, one clear frontmost ground-contact corner at the centre-bottom. All footings, stocks and attached props share the same flat plane. Only the single structure, no ground diamond, thick pedestal, yard, mountain landscape, road, grass, people, animals, text, numbers, level badges, logo or watermark. Square PNG, genuine transparent background with generous padding on every side; complete roof, rope, beams and all supports visible, never clipped. One upgrade stage only, no sheet or comparisons.
Function: IRON MINE extraction outpost, NOT a blacksmith, stonemason or residential cottage. Timber-reinforced dark mine access opening incorporated in low compact grey rock / dressed-stone walls, a modest winding headframe with a coherent hand winch, taut rope and bucket, small recessed bin of dark iron-grey ore with muted rust-brown seams, pickaxe and shovel rack, one warm safety lantern. Timber/slate shelter attached to the mine access. No furnace, molten metal, fire, anvils, cut white stone blocks, blue glowing crystals, steam engine, detached ore cart or long rails leaving the footprint.
LEVEL 1: a modest single-storey iron mining outpost for two workers. Simple oak-reinforced squared tunnel portal with a dark empty interior, low warm-grey stone side walls, a small blue-grey slate gable shelter, one short right-hand timber winding gantry, a hand crank and one bucket at ground level. Small ore bin tucked in the loading bay and a simple tool rack. Compact humble but carefully built. The tunnel opening belongs to this small structure; do not add a hill behind it. The image reference is materials/style only: replace all stonecutting workstations and cut blocks with unmistakable mining equipment and ore.

Use case: stylized-concept. One isolated IRON ORE DEPOSIT resource-node sprite for a medieval fantasy farming town-builder.
Match the reference workshop's detailed crisp pixel-art material rendering, dark outlines, muted blue-grey rock with dark iron-grey facets and restrained rust-brown / ochre iron-bearing seams. No precious gems or glowing crystals. Light from upper-left, hard pixel clusters, no blur, photorealism or glossy 3D.
One compact asymmetrical but balanced cluster of three connected low angular natural rocks, the largest rock behind, smaller rock in front. Clearly readable iron-ore veins embedded in rock faces. Strict orthographic 2:1 isometric ground axes; all stones share one ground plane and a compact one-tile diamond footprint with a clear frontmost bottom contact. This is a mineable natural ore node, separate from the mine building. No tools, timber, building, mine entrance, cave, cart, people, foliage, grass base, ground diamond, terrain slab, pedestal, loose scattered stones outside cluster, cast shadow, text, numbers, border or watermark.
Single centred complete cluster, entire subject visible with generous transparent margins, square PNG with genuine transparent background. Only rock and embedded rust-toned iron seams visible; all surrounding space transparent.
